translationRepairs: After Zhao Yu departed, the general told the two men: "Each of you must furnish your own carriage canopy and crimson robes yourselves."
After Zhao Yu departed, the general told the two men: "Each of you must furnish your own saddled horses and crimson robes yourselves."

Chapter s0101 has corrupt 樾象, which cannot mean “carriage canopy”; CText’s critical text of 田叔列傳 reads 各自具鞍馬新絳衣, and the same paragraph already requires 鞌馬/鞍馬 equipment, so replacing “carriage canopy” with “saddled horses” is the correct repair.
After Zhao Yu left, the general told the two men: "Each of you must prepare your own carriage canopy and crimson robes at your own expense."
After Zhao Yu left, the general told the two men: "Each of you must prepare your own saddled horses and crimson robes at your own expense."
Same corrupt 樾象 in s0101; CText’s edition restores 鞍馬 (“saddled horses”), matching the earlier 鞌馬/鞍馬 kit, so the literal must abandon “carriage canopy” for “saddled horses.”
